      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.{cpp,h} to replace string-based log callbacks with structured btck_LogEntry objects in the C API.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Redesigns the kernel logging interface to deliver structured metadata directly to consumers and decouples the kernel from node logging internals. Downstream consumers previously had to parse formatted strings for metadata, and removing logging.cpp from the kernel build eliminates node-oriented buffering and filtering dependencies (enabling #30342 and #33847). Struct-based callbacks provide durable API value for external consumers building on the library."
